extracted.name: Jeremiah’s Dirty-in-all-the-best-ways-possible Rice
extracted.description: It was so creamy and just the right amount of spice!
instruction_lines: Dice the veggies (if you haven’t already) and add to a sauce pan with the butter and lightly sweat out the aromatics on medium low heat.
Add the flour and seasonings and stir until a light roux forms.
Add the water and bring up to a boil then stir in the rice.
Cook on low until the rice is soft and water is almost completely absorbed.
